t.t: Buying, receiving and installing a module from the OdooSkills store: account, payment, invoice, immediate delivery, Odoo versions covered.

div.p: Buying, receiving, installing. If your question isn't here, it belongs at apps@odooskills.com.

details.summary: Do I need to create an account ?
details.p: Yes. The right to download a paid module is attached to the customer of the order: without an account, a purchase could not be linked to you and you would leave with nothing. The account is created during payment, in two fields.
Credit card and PayPal. Card data is entered on the payment provider's end: it never passes through this site.
In US dollars. The price shown on the listing is the amount invoiced. Your bank may apply its own conversion.
Yes, issued automatically when the order is confirmed and available in your customer area.

details.summary: When do I receive the module ?
details.p: Immediately. As soon as the order is confirmed, the module's listing switches from "Buy" to "Download", and a confirmation email points you back to your apps.

details.summary: Where can I find my purchases later ?
details.p: In your customer area: every module purchased appears there with every Odoo version for which an archive exists. A purchase is never lost.
A .zip archive containing the module folder, ready to drop into your installation.

details.summary: How do I install a module ?

ol.li: Unzip the archive into a folder declared in addons_path.
Enable developer mode, then Apps → Update Apps List.
Search for the module by its name and install it.

details.p: Each module's listing shows what it requires. The store modules it depends on are clickable there.
It depends on the module: its listing shows the versions for which an archive exists, and the catalog lets you filter on them.
Odoo 20 is at the door. It already appears in the selector, without an archive: those will follow the official release.

details.summary: Does a 19.0 module work on an 18.0 database ?
details.p: No. Every major Odoo version changes its interface and its conventions: you need the archive for your version. If it doesn't exist yet, the listing offers the most recent one available and says so.

details.summary: The module won't install, or misbehaves.
details.p: Write to apps@odooskills.com with your Odoo version, the module's name and the full error message. It's the same inbox for the whole store.
The license is shown on the module's listing and in its archive: free modules are under an open-source license, paid modules under a proprietary Odoo license.
Both points are set by the terms of sale, which will be published and presented at payment before sales open.

details.summary: The module I need doesn't exist.
details.p: Describe it: the Request a module form opens a tracked request, budget and version included.

div.p: A question that isn't here ? apps@odooskills.com
